project.name: Dependency Analyser Example
project.description:
Not part of the tool itself. A small, real Maven project that exists to be mvn-installed into the local repository and then fetched back by its own coordinates (DependencyAnalyser.getPom), so tests can run getDependencies against a genuine, externally-resolved pom.xml rather than one hand-assembled inline. See dependency-analyser-implementation's DependencyAnalyserImplIT.
Its only current dependency is slf4j-api. Extend this pom's own dependencies with further, more interesting or corner-case entries (exclusions, a BOM import, a scope that needs careful classpath handling, etc.) as those become worth testing - that is this module's whole purpose.
